findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "catalog" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: mova_catalog_search, mova_catalog_get_background, mova_skill_invoke · Private data: mova_catalog_get_prompt, mova_catalog_get_background, mova_design_calibrate, mova_skill_feedback · Public sink: mova_catalog_get_prompt, mova_skill_invoke, mova_skill_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: mova_catalog_search, mova_catalog_get_background, mova_skill_invoke · Private data: mova_catalog_get_prompt, mova_catalog_get_background, mova_design_calibrate, mova_skill_feedback · Public sink: mova_catalog_get_prompt, mova_skill_invoke, mova_skill_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
